changes.before: Existing data centers unaffected unless they cease operations 60+ days or let a business license lapse.
changes.after: The resolution exempts issuance of business licenses to currently operating businesses, unless operation ceases for 60 days or more or an expired license was not timely renewed. This is not an established blanket exemption from all permitting/development restrictions.

changes.before: 180 days from the March 3, 2026 adoption/vote date, expiring August 30, 2026 (March 3 plus 180 days). WBRC and Birmingham Times both confirm the March 3, 2026 vote date and the six-month term; no separate publication-date lag was found or is needed for this calculation.

changes.after: June 9, 2026 reporting describes adoption of permanent data-center zoning. A July 16, 2026 secondary report says the initial March pause had been lifted. [VERIFY: original effective date, exact lifting date, legal transition and current status remain unresolved.]

changes.before: Applies prospectively to new or expanding large/hyperscale data centers above 20 MW. The Nebius BHM01/Oxmoor project and DC BLOX expansion were reported as exempt because applications or permits were already complete or under review before the moratorium took effect.
